actual_control_history.scope_note: This run preceded the final rollback committed-flag reset, disposal comment, and added native post-publication control. It is not relabeled as a test run of later source bytes.

checks: git diff --check on both changed paths

findings_and_fixes.finding: BaseException after a real candidate load could leave an unpublished native image unowned.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Handle BaseException, dispose uncommitted image, decrement preparation reservation in finally.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Event failure after registry insertion could dispose the image while leaving dangling registry entries.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Roll back both image and admission registries under the same lock before disposal.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Constructor proof or event failure after baseline load could leak the baseline image.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Constructor failure clears its unpublished registries, marks construction closed, and disposes its successfully loaded image.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Token generation raised outside the reservation cleanup guard.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Move token and path generation inside the guarded preparation block.

findings_and_fixes.finding: An interrupted return after successful publication must retain runtime ownership.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Only uncommitted images are disposed. Committed images retain their registry entries and remain subject to the image cap and normal close.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Cleanup telemetry could replace the original cancellation exception; dlclose failure could prevent fd closure.
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Rejection telemetry is best effort after ownership resolution; fd closure is in a finally block.

expected_fault_coverage: cancellation after real native load with failing telemetry
interruption after successful publication followed by actual selection and execution
native_control_status.reason: Model inference lane is reserved. Root explicitly requested one final integrated gate rather than duplicate native execution.

related_cost_review.finding: Session snapshot copying after shutdown previously fell into shared residual cost.
related_cost_review.resolution: native.snapshot now has a separate measured entry charged to the NDU controller, alongside native.shutdown.

scope_limits: The Python host, compiler and loader remain trusted; this is not a guarantee against arbitrary repeated asynchronous interruption or host mutation.
No performance measurement or native correctness result is fabricated by this review.
Prior C++ qualification and benchmark snapshots are preserved; later integration results must bind their own exact source.
